A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Q-chunking research and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E. v4 removes the NeurIPS checklist; the scientific appendices remain available for comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original OGBench and robomimic experiments, including success rates, learning curves, ablations, trajectory analyses, and runtime measurements in Section 5 and Appendix E.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix E, including benchmark comparisons and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The written critic-loss specifications receive corrected reward indexing and bootstrap discounts. These are limited corrections within the existing QC/QC-FQL design, aligning the losses with the backup already stated in Equation 7; no redesigned architecture or changed experimental implementation is documented.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 25 OGBench tasks and three robomimic tasks using the same datasets. Table 6's expanded scene-sparse and puzzle-3x3-sparse labels identify coverage already described in v3.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods, including RLPD variants, SUPE-GT, IQL, ReBRAC, IFQL, FQL, BFN, and their reported chunking or n-step variants. Corrections to baseline equations do not establish different evaluated baseline implementations.

E3.justification: Appendices B–D retain the same data handling, training budgets, 50-episode success-rate evaluation, model configurations, and hyperparameters. No new evaluation protocol or revision to experimental settings is reported.

E4.justification: The Gaussian-policy, n-step, chunk-length, ensemble-size, UTD, trajectory, and resource-efficiency analyses are retained. Their plots and substantive accompanying findings are unchanged, including those in Appendix E.

E5.justification: v4 removes confidence intervals from Table 1 and deletes the checklist's explicit bootstrap-estimation statement. Table 6 and plots retain uncertainty reporting, while Appendix D.2 retains four/five-seed counts and 5000-sample stratified estimation. No change in run counts is established.

E6.justification: Several Table 1 summaries change: cube-double online scores for RLPD and SUPE-GT become 99 and 67 instead of 98 and 66; QC's cube-quadruple online score becomes 73 instead of 74. Table 6 values and plotted results remain unchanged. These are limited summary revisions, without documented reruns.

T1.justification: Equations 4, 11, and 15 change reward summation limits from 1 through h to 0 through h−1. Appendix C restores missing gamma or gamma^h bootstrap factors in Equations 20, 23, 27, and 28. These correct mathematical expressions; Proposition A.1 and its proof remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning temporally coherent exploration, unbiased multi-step backups, and strong offline-to-online performance.

C2.justification: The exploration mechanism, interpretations of ablations, and limitations remain unchanged. These include difficulty selecting chunk length, reduced reactivity with long chunks, and potential weakness when high-frequency feedback is essential.

D1.justification: Checklist removal deletes the explicit statement that the repository supplies data-download instructions. The code link and detailed data-processing, hardware, runtime, and hyperparameter information remain. Appendix C also corrects implementation equations without documenting changed experimental settings.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to prior research are unchanged. Replacing 'motion primitives' with 'movement primitives' is a terminology correction, not a revised relationship to prior work.

P1.justification: v4 removes the standardized NeurIPS checklist, expands acknowledgments, corrects terminology and spelling, and introduces limited text reflow. The main scientific narrative and appendix organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 is reformatted without superscript confidence intervals, Table 5 is enlarged, and Table 6 expands two domain labels. Associated page flow changes, but all plotted figures retain the same content.

improvement.justification: Correcting reward-index and discount-factor errors improves the accuracy and internal consistency of the method description. Removing Table 1's confidence intervals and some checklist disclosures reduces reporting detail, but detailed results and uncertainty settings remain in Table 6 and Appendix D. The mathematical corrections provide a limited net quality improvement.
